movie.title: Hacksaw Ridge
movie.overview: WWII American Army Medic Desmond T. Doss, who served during the Battle of Okinawa, refuses to kill people and becomes the first Conscientious Objector in American history to receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.

facts: Believe it or not, 'Hacksaw Ridge' isn't just a dramatic retelling; it actually draws its story from a real 2004 documentary called *The Conscientious Objector*.
While the story is deeply American, the film's intense production actually took place entirely in Australia, with filming running from September to December 2015.
Desmond Doss's incredible commitment to non-violence was rooted in his faith as a Seventh-day Adventist, a specific detail that shaped his remarkable journey.
